message: Shiori-san's not coming.
She's nowhere to be found.
(Answer the phone)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "It's me. I've found our guy."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You're quiet even on the phone. Scary..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I mean, when we're talking face to face, you nod and react and all that, so it doesn't bother me much. But on the phone, none of that comes across, y'know? So c'mon, say something."
"Where are you?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "He's at the park I told you about yesterday, wandering around like a total creep."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "C'mon, get over here already, before he wanders off."
"I'll be there right away."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Aye aye. You can take it easy, but hurry up, yeah?"
Time to go.
(Playground)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ooh. There you are~"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "He's still here. Look, over there."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "He just keeps wandering around. And whenever a little kid shows up, he just stares at them. What a creep."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Maybe the reason nobody comes here anymore is because of him. Like, maybe people can sense it, y'know. His creepy ghost vibes."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Kids tend to be more sensitive to that stuff than adults, yeah? But I dunno."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, whatever. Let's gooo!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Leave it to me. I'll ask him about Shiorin."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You're not exactly calm right now, so just sit tight and watch, 'kay~"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "'Scuse me~, got a minute~?"

name: Yasuda
message: "Oh... it's you bunch again."

name: Yasuda
message: "What happened to that other woman. Is she not here?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hah? What? You wanna see her or something?"

name: Yasuda
message: "Of course not."

name: Yasuda
message: "...No. Well, in a way, maybe I do. There's still something I want to say to her."

name: Yasuda
message: "She needs to atone for the crime of setting me up. No amount of groveling would be enough. That wouldn't even come close to satisfying my anger and hatred."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So like, did you actually know Shiorin?"

name: Yasuda
message: "Shiorin? You mean Kugayama Shiori?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You know damn well who I mean, dumbass."

name: Yasuda
message: "Are you trying to pick a fight? You don't know what happens when you cross me."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What're you gonna do? Kill me? Like all those kids you kidnapped?"

name: Yasuda
message: "Kill you? Me? Like... those kids?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Stop screwing around. It was you, wasn't it? The guy behind the serial... kidnappings? Yeah, the killings."

name: Yasuda
message: "...Tch. I still remember those reporters crawling all over the place for their newspapers and magazines."

name: Yasuda
message: "Ridiculous. I've never kidnapped or killed anyone."

name: Yasuda
message: "I was just having some fun."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What?"

name: Yasuda
message: "I was just having fun, playing with pitiful kids who were being neglected by their parents. I should be thanked, not criticized."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You were just playing with them? You sure?"

name: Yasuda
message: "That's right, we were only playing. It's a shame they were all just one-off trysts."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...What's that supposed to mean?"

name: Yasuda
message: "I always went all out when playing with them. They'd get so tired, they'd just stop moving."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hah?"

name: Yasuda
message: "Sadly, they're no longer of use once it gets to that point. I did make sure to send them home properly, though."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Is this guy for real? Who talks like that? He's completely delusional."

name: Yasuda
message: "Children are beautiful, yet frail. Or perhaps my love was just too much for them to bear."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Quit playing dumb, you know what you did. You kidnapped those kids and killed them."

name: Yasuda
message: "How many times do I have to tell you? I haven't kidnapped or killed anyone."

name: Yasuda
message: "They were simply put in my care, that's all. I was just playing with them."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Put in your care? By who, exactly?"

name: Yasuda
message: "Kugayama Shiori."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Are you seriously saying that?"

name: Yasuda
message: "What's that face for? You got—"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Pick your words carefully. I've got a short fuse."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Shiorin. Left. Those. Children. With you?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "And then what? Shiorin started kidnapping little girls?"

name: Yasuda
message: "I don't know where she brought them from. I was just looking after them."

name: Yasuda
message: "Normally, I'd just admire them from a distance, but thanks to her, I got to have my share of fun. That is a fact I cannot change."

name: Yasuda
message: "However, there is one thing I absolutely cannot forgive."

name: Yasuda
message: "She ignored my request."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Request?"

name: Yasuda
message: "Her younger sister."
"My sister...?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Shiorin?"

name: Yasuda
message: "Ha... hahaha! I knew it. I knew you were skulking around nearby!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Why else would I have bothered humoring these idiots' pointless chatter for so long?"

name: Yasuda
message: "It was so you'd overhear me! So I could teach you the TRUTH!"

name: Yasuda
message: "I said you killed your sister, right? Fine, I'll admit it. I lied. I figured it would drive you into despair."

name: Yasuda
message: "But then I realized something. For someone like you, who truly cares about her sister, the truth would be far more devastating!"

name: Shiori
message: "...and what's the truth...?

name: Yasuda
message: "Heh... haha... hahaha!"

name: Yasuda
message: "This is what you get, your punishment for tarnishing my honor and driving me to my death. Now suffer as much as you can, Kugayama Shiori!"

name: Shiori
message: "And what exactly is the truth?!"

name: Yasuda
message: "You see, your precious, precious sister..."

name: Yasuda
message: "I made sure..."

name: Yasuda
message: "...to have *lots* of fun with her."

name: Yasuda
message: "Huh?"

name: Shiori
message: "You... killed... my sister...?"

name: Shiori
message: "You... KILLED HER?!"

name: Yasuda
message: "W-Wait!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Gyagh!"

name: Yasuda
message: "S-Stop..."

name: Yasuda
message: "Hihh!"

name: Yasuda
message: "H-Help... m-me..."

name: Yasuda
message: "Gihh...!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Seriously...?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm... sorry..."

name: Shiori
message: "I... couldn't... protect..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Wha... crap, that thing's bad news. Let's bail, or we're next."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey, did you hear me? That thing's not Shiorin anymore. There's no fixing it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Her innocence is beside the point now. Just look at her. It's already too late."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Give it up, we're leaving. You don't wanna die, right?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Do what you want. I'm getting outta here."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Later."
(Go somewhere else)
(Shrine)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "C'mon, we're leaving!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Didn't see that coming... Man, that was insane. She's basically a monster, or yokai, or whatever now."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So, uh, did you notice Shiorin was there earlier? Was she nearby the whole time?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What, you're ignoring me now? Well, I guess that was pretty shocking. Can't blame you for being stunned."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You think that *thing* will ever go back to normal? I don't think so. *Its* mind's completely broken."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey, where're you going? You look like you've got somewhere in mind."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Why the shrine? What're you gonna do here?"
(Pray)
(Put in an offering)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Praying to the local deity? I think it's a waste of time, but... hey, if it helps you feel better, go ahead. I might as well join you."
"Greetings."
"I was thinking of asking you to indulge me in some idle chatter, but it appears now is not the time."
"Now, how can this deity help you?"
"I want to help Shiori-san pass on."
"I'd like to say that were easy, but..."
"It's too much for a fading deity like me, one who has lost too many believers."
"Even so, I can't just turn you away."
"Lend me just an ounce of your strength, and I will grant your wish."
"No, I suppose I should be clearer about this. 'Lend' isn't the right word, since you won't be getting it back."
"Are you prepared to pay the price for your wish?"
"I can't tell you what the price is. Those are the rules."
"It could be something trivial, or it could be something very important."
"You won't ever recover it, and nothing will ever take its place."
"It will be gone, for eternity."
"Even so, do you still want your wish granted?"
"Yes."
"No."
"I see. Very well."
"Now then..."
"Let us bind the pact."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "That woman's suspicious, I tell you. Where did she get all that money from? There's no way her husband's earning that much."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "But I know what's really going on. That woman, she's doing *that* kind of work! It wouldn't make sense otherwise!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "So that's her. It helps that she's very easy to spot."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, that's right. It's true she knows a lot, but..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "And those flashy clothes too. You can tell at a glance, she's definitely doing night work."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Indeed. She's rather vulgar. What's more..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You'd normally need a prettier face for that line of work. Something's fishy."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "She's been talking nonstop, alone, even though no one is responding."

name: Shiori
message: "I might be wrong, but... despite how she looks, she might be barely holding it together. Her cognition is a bit... no, more than a bit off..."

name: Shiori
message: "Her sense of time seems warped too, and she behaves as though she's still alive."

name: Shiori
message: "But then, just when you think she's just rambling, she suddenly starts making sense. I really don't know what to make of it..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I see..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Her trigger was getting interrupted, was it?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, I think so. She gets really angry if you interrupt her, but when you keep quiet, she calms down right away."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I see, and the conversation itself is erratic and hard to control."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. She usually just talks about whatever she wants, but she latches on if it's a topic she's interested in... I think? Probably?"

name: Shiori
message: "But then she gets sidetracked almost immediately..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Would you mind leaving this to me for the moment? I had a similar relative, so I know how to deal with their type."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, please do."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'll ask her directly about the Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case. For now, let's draw out as much information as we can, and then sort through it later."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Well then, shall we try it?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Even if she does have a sponsor, it still makes you wonder. Who would choose someone like *her*? Well, they do say tastes differ, so I guess some people just have weird preferences—"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Ah, why hello there, Ma'am."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh my, hello there. Out shopping with the family? Did you hear? Scallions are cheap today, especially the long ones."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I see. By the way, did you hear? You know, about *that*."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh what's this, which one are we talking about? Tell me more."

name: Shiori
message: "...Amazing. She won her over in an instant..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Do you remember that abduction case from a little while back? I have some shocking news."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Just between us, but apparently there was another culprit. A high school girl, from what I heard."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh dear. And that's *all* you've heard?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Oh? Could you perhaps know more about it?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Know more? *I* was the one they interviewed! I was their source! I can't remember if it was for TV or a newspaper, though."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh, she seems to know even more than we expected... What a pleasant surprise..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Impressive, but I guess it's no surprise. What did you tell them? Ah... is this something you're not supposed to say?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh it's not a problem at all. My testimony's already been out nationwide. On TV, or maybe in a magazine?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You see, I know exactly who that high school girl was. After all, I saw it with my own two eyes!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Oh my, but is it really okay for you to tell us something like that?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh, it's fine, don't worry about it. You're about the only one who doesn't know. Everyone's up to speed already."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You see, I saw her myself, with the culprit, no less!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Are you saying the culprit is still at large?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Of course he is! And what's worse, everyone already knows who he is. It's none other than Yasuda-san's son!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Takeyuki-san, was it?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Yes, that's right. That's his name, alright! He's always at the park, staring at kids, you see. With that sleazy grin on his face. He's got to be the culprit!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And so who was the girl? The high school accomplice?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "It was Kugayama-san."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "It was that Kugayama girl! She was the one helping the culprit! I saw it myself!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Shiori-san, was it?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Yes, yes, that's right! Shiori-chan! To think a girl like that would kidnap children. Goes to show you really can't judge people by how they look..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You really didn't know? It's common knowledge, you know. Everyone knows Shiori-chan was the accomplice."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Naturally, I told the interviewers that too, that Shiori-chan was the one doing the kidnapping."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I'm good at this sort of thing, you see. When I saw the case on the news, it just clicked."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "The thing is, even little kids wouldn't go along with a guy as shady Yasuda-san, so there had to be someone else doing the kidnapping."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "And Shiori-chan was a high schooler too. Kids let their guard down around teenage girls."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Shiori-chan would kidnap the kids and take them to Yasuda-san. That was how they did it."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I bet it was blackmail. She probably had some nasty little secret tucked away. Well, look at her now. Got what she deserved."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Please hold back, you two. I can only imagine how you two are feeling right now, but there is something that concerns me. Let's keep her talking for now."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "There are even eyewitnesses, you know? They all saw Shiori-chan walking around with the children. And more than once, too! To the point that EVERYONE here has seen it!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I saw her together with Yasuda-san myself, you know. Right at the decisive moment, the decisive moment, I tell you!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "There's no doubt about it. The two of them were accomplices. They kidnapped children together and killed them. Terrifying, isn't it?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "By the way, what kind of person was Shiori-san? Does she resemble anyone here?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "No, not at all. That girl was far more distinctive."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "What about her uniform? Was she from the same school as this girl, for example?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "No, her uniform was different too. It wasn't a sailor uniform, I think. No, I'm sure of it."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I made sure to tell them every detail in that interview, you know. Honestly, what in the world are the police doing?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Shiori-chan ended up dying before they could catch her. An accident... or was it suicide? What was it again?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "She probably couldn't take it anymore. Used by a man and... no, I think she was tossed aside?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "She went so far as to commit crimes for him, only to be thrown away, so she killed herself. Isn't that the most likely explanation? Yes, that's got to be it. I'm sure of it!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "And once Shiori-chan died, kids stopped getting kidnapped, right? The case ended right there and then."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Which means that's exactly what it was, right? Shiori-chan was the one doing the kidnapping, so of course the case would end."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Foolish girl. It just goes to show that kids these days don't know how to think anymore."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "If only she'd just behaved herself, her family wouldn't have ended up so miserable."

name: Shiori
message: "...Her family ended up miserable?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I mean, their daughter turned into a criminal, and everyone around here knew. It was common knowledge, that Shiori-chan was the accomplice."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "They're the family of a criminal, you know? Of course people would look at them differently. There's no avoiding it. That's just how society is."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I was even kind enough to show my concern for them, you know? I'd always ask them how they were doing."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "And then they stopped coming here altogether. Everyone was wondering if they'd switched to a different supermarket or something."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "But no, that wasn't it. They moved away somewhere. Well, of course they did. They couldn't exactly live here anymore, could they?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Everyone was talking about Shiori-chan. I suppose it didn't help that my little deductions were spot on."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I even told the interviewers the truth of the incident, you see. I was the first to notice it. That's right, it was me. Me!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "If I hadn't gone and exposed the whole incident, I wonder if things might've turned out differently."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "But it's Shiori-chan's fault, really. If only she'd behaved herself, her family wouldn't have had to suffer all that shame."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Honestly, what a foolish girl. Stupid kids do stupid things, I guess."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Ma'am, you saw the culprit together with Kugayama Shiori, correct?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Yes, that's right! I saw it with my own eyes, the decisive moment! I was even interviewed about it!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Do you recognize this woman in the uniform here?"

name: Shiori
message: "......Do you know who I am?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What are you talking about? Of course I don't. Who're you, her little sister or something?"

name: Shiori
message: "Kugayama, Shiori."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Huh?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm Kugayama Shiori."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That's strange. You said you saw the culprit together with Kugayama-san, didn't you?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I-I did see her! Stop spouting nonsense! The one I saw wasn't you!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Shiori-chan is dead, you know?! She killed herself out of guilt! How shameless, pretending to be someone who's already dead!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "It's because of girls like you that these weird crimes keep happening! Ugh, how unpleasant!"

name: Shiori
message: "...So this is what it all comes down to, isn't it?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Wh-What? What is it now?!"

name: Shiori
message: "You didn't even know who I was, and yet you spread all those rumors that I was an accomplice."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I said, it wasn't you! It was Shiori-chan! Shiori-chan!"

name: Shiori
message: "You didn't even see anything, yet you went around spreading things that never happened as if they were facts..."

name: Shiori
message: "Because of that... my whole family... my father, my mother, my little sister, all of them were branded as a criminal's family..."

name: Shiori
message: "You kept spreading the rumors, then more and more people pointed fingers at us... until we were finally driven out of this town..."

name: Shiori
message: "...That's what it all comes down to, isn't it?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Could you stop painting me as the villain here? Everything I said was true, all of it. I'm the type who hates lies, you know."

name: Shiori
message: "...You can say whatever you want about me. I'm already dead. It doesn't matter what anyone says anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "But you... you dragged my family's name through the mud. You cornered and hurt the people I love most..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I said, stop making me look like the bad guy here! Everything I said was true!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Besides, it's their own fault they ran away! They raised their daughter wrong! Raising a criminal like that, what a bunch of failures as parents!"

name: Shiori
message: "You'll pay for that..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Kugayama-san?"

name: Shiori
message: "You'll pay for that... You'll pay for that..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...This is bad. Ma'am, please get away, quick. You've set off Kugayama-san's trigger."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Wh-What? What is wrong with you?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Never mind that for now. Please, you need to leave."

name: Shiori
message: "You'll pay for that!"
"Shiori-san."
"Calm down."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Wha—wait! What is wrong with you people?!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Get away! Now!"

name: Shiori
message: "Because of you, my family...!"
"Shiori-san."
"Calm down."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "As I said, stop blaming others! This is all their fault, not mine! But you just love pointing fingers, don't you?! I see your parents were trash too!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "What are you doing?! You're pouring oil into the fire!"

name: Shiori
message: "Again...! You've insulted my family again!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I'm not! I'm just stating facts! I swear, you and your parents are both idiots. Idiots!"

name: Shiori
message: "You'll pay, you'll pay, YOU'LL PAY!"

name: Shiori
message: "I'll kill you."
"Shiori-san!"
"No!"
The charm...

name: Shiori
message: "Wha...... what just......?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Thank goodness. Have you calmed down?"

name: Shiori
message: "...I-I'm so sorry, I..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What is your problem already?! You think sorry's gonna cut it?! After you went and treated me like the villain?!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "ME, of all people! Pinning the blame on a model citizen like ME! All you do is point fingers!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Honestly, what were your parents thinking?! How bad do you have to be to raise a child this rude?! Ugh, how awful!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You two, please step back. I can't be sure what will happen from this point on."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Kugayama-san, the reason I tried to stop you was that I didn't want you to dirty your hands."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "But I actually feel the same way. This vulgar being deserves to be punished."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "V-Vulgar... A-Are you talking about me?! How rude! How dare you speak to your elders like that!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'm the elder here."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What did you say?!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Kugayama-san. There is no need for you to stain your hands. In my experience, this type suffers on their own, simply by learning the truth."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Would you stop blabbing already?! What is wrong with you people?!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Very well. I'll explain it in a way that even someone like you can understand."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "A 'model citizen' like you might have just stayed silent, but I'm not that kind of person."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Your vulgar curiosity sullied the honor of Kugayama-san and her cherished family. And naturally, you deserve punishment befitting that."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Punishment? What punishment? I didn't do anything wrong!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I see you haven't even realized that you're dead."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Hah?!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Remember when I said I was your elder? The truth is, I have been dead for several decades now."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You are the same. You've become a ghost, aimlessly wandering this world."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What, are you trying to invite me into some kind of cult?! Stop talking nonsense—no one's gonna fall for that stupid story!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Has anyone responded to you aside from us?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Hah?!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "No matter how much you called out, you were ignored."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Wh-What are you talking about?! How incredibly rude! Of course that's not true!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Try it, then."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Just what in the world is wrong with you?! I'm losing my patience here!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Go on. Call out to your friends, like you always do."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Who do you think you are?! Fine, just watch!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "...Ah! Saito-san! Saito-saaaan! Get over here for a bit! I'm being harassed by some strange kids!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Saito-san! Hey, Saito-san! I'm talking to you! Stop ignoring me! Hey!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It appears this 'Saito-san' didn't even look at you."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Tch! Ah! Hayashi-san! Hey, Hayashi-san!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Hey! You! Ah, it's been so long, hasn't it? Did you know? The scallions are so cheap today!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Hey, you! I said hey! Hey!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Why? Why is everyone ignoring me...?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "So, do you understand now?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "B-But I... I always chat here, and..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "With whom?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Huh?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Who are you always chatting with?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Wh-Who? Well, everyone, and..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And who exactly is this 'everyone'?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "That should be obvious..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "...should be obvious..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It seems you finally understand. You've been talking to yourself, all this time."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "There is no 'everyone.' You were alone. You have always been alone."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "No one can hear you. No one will ever hear you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "No one can see you either. And no one ever will."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Because you are already dead."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Shall I say it once more?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You. Are. Already. Dead."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "...No... no... it's a lie... you're lying..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Now remember. Why you died, and how you died."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Go on. Remember."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Oh dear, are you alright? You're bleeding."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Dear, oh dear... it seems you met quite a gruesome end."
Her body begins to bend and twist in on itself...

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "...kh... s-someone... p-please... someone... h-he...lp..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "...help...someone...he...lp...me...!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Buddy, Kugayama-san, shall we go?"

name: Shiori
message: "Huh...? A-Are you sure?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Would you like to make her suffer more?"

name: Shiori
message: "N-No, that's not what I..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'm joking. There is no need for you to feel guilty. This was something I did of my own accord."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Come, let's go. We've obtained the information we needed. There's no reason to stay here any longer."

name: Shiori
message: "...Okay."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "...s-some...one..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Help... meeeeee........!!!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Apologies. That may have gotten a bit too intense. I didn't expect it to become that grotesque."

name: Shiori
message: "...Yes... I do feel *some* guilt... but..."

name: Shiori
message: "It seems... I'm not a very good person either."

name: Shiori
message: "Because I feel... oddly satisfied."

name: Shiori
message: "...I'm sorry. I made you play the villain."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "As I said before, I acted of my own accord."

name: Shiori
message: "...What do you think will happen to her?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If her will is strong enough, she'll recover. If not, I assume she'll simply fade away."

name: Shiori
message: "Fade away..."

name: Shiori
message: "Back then... if I'd let my anger get the better of me, and brought my axe down on her..."

name: Shiori
message: "Would I have... killed her?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That would depend on her, but the chances are high."

name: Shiori
message: "So even ghosts die if they are killed..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Ghosts don't age, but they are not immortal."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I have seen several cases where a ghost suffered an injury that would have been fatal to the living. They weakened and vanished as a result."

name: Shiori
message: "An injury that would be fatal to the living..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Best not dwell on it."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? Y-Yes... Back then, I was genuinely planning to..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And that is only natural. You are a ghost, and she set off your trigger."

name: Shiori
message: "My trigger... Ah, I see... so that was my..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It seems your trigger is your family, Kugayama-san. When your parents were insulted, you lost control of your emotions."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, I couldn't hold my anger back... or rather, I wasn't even trying to hold it back..."

name: Shiori
message: "Driven purely by rage, I was about to... summon my axe, and..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Even I would react the same if someone were to set me off."

name: Shiori
message: "But then, all of a sudden, the anger drained away, and before I knew it, I was calm again, like all that rage had been a lie..."

name: Shiori
message: "It was your voice, echoing directly into my head as my emotions boiled over."

name: Shiori
message: "If it weren't for you, I would've done something I can't ever take back. Thank you, truly."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Perhaps we were even fortunate to find out what your trigger is."

name: Shiori
message: "Meaning...?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Someone who cherishes their family to that extent would never harm their own sister."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... y-yes, I guess that's true. But still... she could've died because of my carelessness, and..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I suppose I can't rule that possibility out. However, I don't believe you're the kind of person who would hand her over to a kidnapper, even if by accident."

name: Shiori
message: "...Thank you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Kugayama-san is not Girl A. To be certain of that, let us sort through the testimony of that woman."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, let's."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "She claims to have seen Kugayama-san together with the culprit. However, she did not know Kugayama-san directly."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "What she most likely witnessed was, 'a high school girl together with the culprit.'"

name: Shiori
message: "She knew that I died. And also... that the incident ended after my death."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "In her mind, a 'truth' had already taken shape—that Kugayama-san was the accomplice."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That delusion likely led her to the hasty conclusion that the high school girl she witnessed was you."

name: Shiori
message: "But she wasn't wearing a sailor uniform like me."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Someone does come to mind, but... let's set that aside for now."

name: Shiori
message: "I... probably have the same person in mind."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "We don't have definitive proof, and that woman just now seemed to have an unreliable memory. We shouldn't take her account at face value."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "She also claimed that Kugayama-san was walking together with a child, but even if that were true, we can safely disregard it."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Because you often spent time out and about with your sister, correct?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. I took her to the park, and probably... went on walks with her too."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If that's the case, then there's nothing unnatural about her statement. You were simply with your sister, that's all."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "However, she did witness the culprit together with a high school girl. That in itself was likely true, though twisted by malice."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "There is no evidence that allows us to conclude that Kugayama-san is Girl A. If anything, I believe we have already gathered enough evidence to safely rule it out."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "All that remains is to find the high school girl who was with the culprit. No, simply finding her will not be enough."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If it turns out that this high school girl was involved in the incident..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Then we can prove Kugayama-san's innocence."

name: Shiori
message: "So far, all we have is vague information, like the uniform not being a sailor outfit..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I cannot state it with certainty, but if I were to name one suspicious individual, it would be..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Aoi Lumina."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "The fact that you and our buddy became aware of Aoi Lumina's existence."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And that Aoi Lumina's name came up through Kirishiki Nagisa-san's testimony in a way no one could have expected."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If these were not mere coincidences, but matters of inevitability..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Then I cannot help but believe that Aoi Lumina is also involved in the Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Uribayashi Rina, who attempted to abduct a child in the past, was unrelated to the kidnappings."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "The most suspicious individual has now been cleared, which makes Aoi Lumina all the more suspicious."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Though I'm well aware that a theory based on 'ties' may sound like nothing more than occult nonsense."

name: Shiori
message: "True... but then again, our very existence is occult."

name: Shiori
message: "I think following an occult theory is the right thing to do, for ghosts like us."

name: Shiori
message: "Still... how are we going to track down Aoi Lumina?"

name: Shiori
message: "No... rather than tracking her down..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Right. Now that I think about it, that may not be the important part."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Even if we were to find her, would she even admit her involvement?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... right... We only have the supermarket lady's testimony, which is unreliable. We've got no evidence at all..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Even if we were to confirm it with Kirishiki-san, all we would learn is whether or not she was the one who killed Kirishiki-san, nothing more."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "As you said, we have no evidence. In short, we have no way to link Aoi Lumina to the Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If every encounter has meaning, then it stands to reason that you and our buddy may have already met Girl A."

name: Shiori
message: "If we already know her, then..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "There are multiple suspects. We cannot yet narrow them down to one."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Even if we were to question each of them directly, it's hard to believe they'd confess so readily."

name: Shiori
message: "That's true, I guess..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "To begin with, our reasoning rests entirely on occult theory, which is no different from a hunch."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Rather than searching for random individuals, it is simply more efficient to start with those close at hand. That's all there is to it."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Even if that hunch were correct and allowed us to narrow down our suspect, we would still lack information."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "We do not yet have sufficient grounds. If we were to act without solid evidence, we would not be able to corner the culprit—even if we found them."

name: Shiori
message: "...Right. Hmm... sufficient grounds... and more information..."

name: Shiori
message: "...Wouldn't it be best to ask the person who knows this case better than anyone else?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yasuda Takeyuki, then?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. Even if I wasn't Girl A... the fact that he knew me means I must have been involved in the case in some way."

name: Shiori
message: "And he is unquestionably at the center of it."

name: Shiori
message: "But why did he say I was the culprit? Why does he hate me so much?"

name: Shiori
message: "...I think I can ask him calmly now. Thanks to both of you, my heart feels lighter."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I cannot say if he will speak honestly, but if that is what you wish to do, then there is no reason for me to stop you."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. But, yes, you're right. Whether or not he'll answer honestly is... questionable at best."

name: Shiori
message: "...I just thought of something... that child..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That child? Ah..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That thought-form, you mean."

name: Shiori
message: "Right. She seems to be afraid of high school girls... or at least women who look like high school girls."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Most likely, assuming our hypothesis is correct—that she is a conglomeration of the victims' and bereaved families' regrets."

name: Shiori
message: "What do you think would happen if she saw an adult man?"

name: Shiori
message: "I've been keeping an eye on her, but... she doesn't seem to react to people who are just passing by, male or female."

name: Shiori
message: "If she only reacts to ghosts, then that means she can tell the difference, right?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Given her interest in our buddy, it seems she can identify individuals to some extent as well."

name: Shiori
message: "Then how would she react to that man—Yasuda-san?"

name: Shiori
message: "Would she reject him the same way she does us? Or would she recognize him as the one who killed her, and show some kind of special reaction?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I cannot say. But if she does react differently..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Setting aside the dead children... there is only one thing the bereaved families would want to do to the culprit."

name: Shiori
message: "...Revenge?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Most likely."

name: Shiori
message: "It'd be fine if her vengeance were directed only at the culprit... but judging by how she reacts to us, it'd probably be indiscriminate..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Her perception of age is rather broad too. She mistook me for a high schooler, after all."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe it wasn't that. Maybe she just genuinely thought you looked young."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If that's the case, then she is a very good child indeed. It makes me want to pat her on the head."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe~... Hey, would you mind telling me more about Yasuda-san?"

name: Shiori
message: "I know we looked him up online earlier, but we didn't really go into the details."

name: Shiori
message: "Before we speak to him, we should make sure we understand what kind of person he is."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Understood. Once I tell you what I know, we will go meet Yasuda."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, please."
(Children's Park)

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, your phone is ringing... The caller is... I guess I don't even need to ask."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "To think she'd call at a time like this... Could I be reading too much into it?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I've been making excuses to delay our answer, but perhaps it is time to steel ourselves."
(Answer the phone)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yo~. Took ya long enough."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So, how's it going? Things working out?"
"Who are you, exactly?"
"Aoi Lumina-san?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Who? I mean..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah... guess the cat's outta the bag."

name: Shiori
message: "...Aoi Lumina-san."

name: Lumina
message: "Ahh, yeah. Figures."

name: Lumina
message: "Nagisa suddenly getting her act together was, like... totally unexpected, I guess?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh? What? Who?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Okay, maybe that was a bit too obvious."

name: Shiori
message: "So you really are..."

name: Lumina
message: "Yep, you got me. But damn, can't believe I got found out 'cause of Nagisa of all people... This sucks."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...I see. It seems a certain someone was following us as well."

name: Lumina
message: "Pretty good, aren't I? Oh, and I don't do that anymore. I've actually been laying low. But yeah, I'd probably just make things worse if I kept lying."

name: Shiori
message: "Why... why didn't you just tell us?"

name: Lumina
message: "C'mon, try putting yourselves in my shoes for a sec."

name: Lumina
message: "My bestie thinks I killed her, and you guys think I'm a kidnapper."

name: Lumina
message: "How was I supposed to tell you the truth? 'Course I'd lie."

name: Lumina
message: "Well... I mean, the kidnapper part ain't wrong, though."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You admitted it rather easily."

name: Lumina
message: "I mean, it's not like I did it 'cause I wanted to. Like, who the heck would even do something like that willingly?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Was he threatening you?"

name: Lumina
message: "Well... yeah, something like that... but I had my own reasons too."

name: Lumina
message: "Even if I told you the truth, there's no way you'd let me go, yeah? So 'course I'd lie."

name: Lumina
message: "Especially to you, Shiorin."

name: Lumina
message: "I kinda thought I could lighten my sins a bit by telling you about him, but, uh..."

name: Shiori
message: "What do you mean? Tell me..."

name: Shiori
message: "Lumina-san?"

name: Lumina
message: "I'm... sorry about your lil' sis."

name: Lumina
message: "...It was all my fault. I'm really sorry."

name: Shiori
message: "W-Wait... my sister? What do you..."

name: Lumina
message: "...I'm sorry. Bye-bye."

name: Shiori
message: "I said wait! Hey!"

name: Shiori
message: "...Wait... please..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Kugayama-san."

name: Shiori
message: "...It's okay. Yeah... I'm okay."

name: Shiori
message: "No, not yet. Until we have definite proof, I won't believe it."

name: Shiori
message: "I'll confront the culprit directly. I'll make him talk. About everything... every last thing."

name: Shiori
message: "So please, tell me."

name: Shiori
message: "Everything you know about Yasuda Takeyuki."
(Playground)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...That must be him, I take it?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Are you okay? If you're scared, I can speak to him instead."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. But I have to do this myself. It's not something I should leave to someone else."

name: Shiori
message: "I've already seen you make people talk plenty of times. I want to see this through myself."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...That girl might be helpful as well."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "She's hiding over there. Look, can you see her?"

name: Shiori
message: "She's pissed as hell right now..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Her reaction is clearly different from when we approached her. I sense intense hatred—murderous intent, even."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If merely seeing him provokes such a reaction, then approaching him could lead her to truly carry out her revenge."

name: Shiori
message: "But we can't really test that... can we?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "True, but if we play our cards right, we may be able to use her to draw out a confession."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If he really is the culprit, then nothing would scare him more than his victims taking revenge."

name: Shiori
message: "Use her...? Yes, I understand. Okay, let's..."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, right. Hey, can I borrow your charm?"

name: Shiori
message: "If he starts talking about my sister, depending on what he says... I think I might lose myself again."

name: Shiori
message: "So... would it be alright if I relied on that charm's divine power, and on your kindness as well?"
(Hand over the charm)

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, I've got this. I'll do my best."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'll refrain from interfering, but I will step in if things go out of control."
"Do your best."
"Don't push yourself."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. Well then, shall we go?"

name: Suspicious Man
message: "You've got some nerve showing your face to me. What's with the crowd, Kugayama Shiori?"

name: Shiori
message: "There's something I want to ask you."

name: Shiori
message: "...Yasuda Takeyuki-san."

name: Yasuda
message: "Why do you know my name?"

name: Shiori
message: "So you finally remembered—is what I'd like to say, but we never actually knew each other, did we?"

name: Yasuda
message: "...And what of it? Answer my question."

name: Shiori
message: "I had someone look you up online. Looks like you're quite famous."

name: Shiori
message: "I hear you were your father's secretary. Though it seems you weren't particularly diligent about your work."

name: Yasuda
message: "You dare... Did you come here looking for a fight?"

name: Shiori
message: "I told you, didn't I? I'm here because there's something I want to ask."

name: Shiori
message: "Why did you lie?"

name: Yasuda
message: "Excuse me?!"

name: Shiori
message: "You said I killed you. But that was a lie, wasn't it? Your obituary never said you were murdered."

name: Shiori
message: "It clearly stated it was a suicide."

name: Shiori
message: "So why did you lie that I killed you?"

name: Shiori
message: "You said I killed my sister, but that was a lie too, wasn't it?"

name: Shiori
message: "Why do you hate me so much that you'd tell something so cruel?"

name: Shiori
message: "We didn't even know each other. I probably didn't even know your name when I was still alive."

name: Shiori
message: "And yet you came to hate me, all on your own."

name: Shiori
message: "Why?"

name: Yasuda
message: "...On my own, you say? The nerve!"

name: Shiori
message: "I didn't kill you. I didn't even do anything to you. Isn't that right?"

name: Yasuda
message: "Cut the crap!"

name: Yasuda
message: "It was because of you! YOU got in my way! Everything went wrong because of you!"

name: Shiori
message: "I... got in your way?"

name: Yasuda
message: "That's right! It was YOUR fault! YOU'RE the reason why I had to die!"

name: Yasuda
message: "If you hadn't been there, your sister... I... I would have..."

name: Shiori
message: "My sister...? What did you do to my sister?"

name: Yasuda
message: "If you hadn't gotten in my way, I would've...!"

name: Yasuda
message: "No, no, no. Phew, that was close. I lost my temper there. It's always been a bad habit of mine."

name: Yasuda
message: "I just realized. Why do I have to carefully explain everything to the likes of you?"

name: Shiori
message: "What... did you do to my sister?"

name: Yasuda
message: "I'm right, aren't I? Why should *I* answer your questions?"

name: Shiori
message: "What did you do to my sister?!"

name: Yasuda
message: "What do you think? Curious? Of course you are!"

name: Yasuda
message: "But no, I'm not telling. Why? Because I hate you, that's why."

name: Yasuda
message: "You'll never know. And you'll suffer in that ignorance, for eternity. That will be my revenge."

name: Shiori
message: "Look behind you."

name: Yasuda
message: "Hah?"

name: Shiori
message: "That little ghost girl has been watching you this entire time."

name: Yasuda
message: "...What on earth are you talking about?"

name: Shiori
message: "You want revenge. So does she."

name: Shiori
message: "That girl wants revenge on you as well."

name: Yasuda
message: "...What was that?"

name: Shiori
message: "You killed her. It's only her right to exact revenge."

name: Shiori
message: "That's why I brought her with me. I never expected you to answer anything to begin with."

name: Yasuda
message: "What could a child possibly do?"

name: Shiori
message: "A child's *ghost*, you mean. No, I suppose it'd be more accurate to call her a wraith."

name: Shiori
message: "Your age or sex doesn't matter when you're a ghost. You'll understand soon enough."

name: Shiori
message: "Physical strength is irrelevant. She hates you. She curses you. And just like that, you will die."

name: Yasuda
message: "Hah. I'm already dead, you know?"

name: Shiori
message: "And you'll still die. Even *if* you're a ghost."

name: Shiori
message: "Turn around and see for yourself. Look at her face."

name: Shiori
message: "She's glaring at you. She's about to curse you."

name: Shiori
message: "I had her wait, though. I still have to hear the truth from you."

name: Shiori
message: "But one word from me, and she'll leap at you right away..."

name: Shiori
message: "...and curse you to death."

name: Shiori
message: "Quivering in fear just from that? Is this why you go after kids instead?"

name: Yasuda
message: "You... Watch your tongue, or I'll kill you."

name: Shiori
message: "Answer me. What did you do to my sister?"

name: Shiori
message: "I don't care what happened between us anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "So answer me."

name: Shiori
message: "What did you do... to my sister?!"

name: Shiori
message: "ANSWER ME!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Oh, I know. I know how to make you suffer more."

name: Yasuda
message: "I did not kill any children. I absolutely refuse to admit that."

name: Yasuda
message: "I was simply playing with them, like any good friend would. Until they were completely exhausted, of course."

name: Yasuda
message: "It's true. My claim that you killed your sister was a lie. I said it in anger, and that was my mistake."

name: Yasuda
message: "I shouldn't have lied. Because telling you the truth would've driven you even deeper into despair."

name: Shiori
message: "What did you do... to my sister?"

name: Yasuda
message: "Do I really have to spell it out for you?"

name: Yasuda
message: "I made sure to have plenty of 'fun' with her."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Kugayama-san, please calm down."

name: Shiori
message: "Enough... Please leave."

name: Yasuda
message: "Hah?"

name: Shiori
message: "Go!"

name: Shiori
message: "Get lost. Don't ever show your face in front of me again."

name: Shiori
message: "If you do, that girl cursing you is going to be the least of your worries."

name: Shiori
message: "...Because I'll kill you myself!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Pfft. Hahaha! What a shame you'll never get to see your sister again."

name: Shiori
message: "Get lost already!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Oh, I will. Gladly."

name: Yasuda
message: "This feels great. Haha... HAHAHAHAHA!!!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Kugayama-san."
"You okay?"
"Don't overdo it."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes... thank you, I'm fine, really."

name: Shiori
message: "I lost my composure a bit, but I managed to speak to him properly, all the way through, without losing myself. Your charm really saved me back there."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I think you were right to use that child to corner him."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...No, that was a strange way to put it. I'm sorry."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, it's okay. Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "I didn't take everything he said at face value. He was so full of hatred toward me, that all he did was lie."

name: Shiori
message: "I just thought talking any further would be pointless."

name: Shiori
message: "Still... I wonder if it was wrong of me to let him go."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I really do think it would have been fine to set that child on him."

name: Shiori
message: "Right... maybe I should've had."

name: Shiori
message: "But it doesn't look like she chased him, and forcing her to exact revenge would be... too cruel."

name: Shiori
message: "It's getting dark. Shall we... call it a day?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Are you sure?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. There's nothing more we can do..."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, I suppose so. I've done everything I could."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you, both of you. And I'm sorry for causing you so much trouble."

name: Shiori
message: "Shall we part ways here?"

name: Shiori
message: "...I'm sorry. I just... want to be alone for a bit."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Very well. Then our buddy and I will take our leave."
"See you."
"Goodbye."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, be careful on your way back."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Well, that wasn't the outcome we'd hoped for. Unfortunately, we had no way to verify the truth of that man's words."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You can still 'see' Kugayama-san and me. As long as that bond remains unbroken, there may yet be something we can do. However..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "For now, perhaps we should simply leave her alone."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'll take my leave here and return to the library. Good work back there."
"You too."
"Goodbye."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If you decide to resume the investigation, let me know. Goodbye for now."
Time to head home.
Shiori-san isn't here.

name: Shiori
message: "Boo!"

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, surprised?"
"Yes."
"Not at all."

name: Shiori
message: "Really? Playing dead never seems to surprise you, so that was kind of a last resort. Ehehe, I guess it's worth trying things out."

name: Shiori
message: "Looks like I finally managed to surprise you. I'm so proud of myself right now..."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh... is that so? I guess that was a bit too forced. My fake deaths don't really surprise you, and I was out of ideas..."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay... I basically just admitted it, didn't I? That my fake deaths were just a running gag, and weren't actually about getting my memories back..."

name: Shiori
message: "...Good job on digging your own grave, Kugayama Shiori."

name: Shiori
message: "I guess jumping from the shadows... wasn't the most appropriate way to scare someone, considering I'm a ghost..."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sorry. I really do regret it."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... right. I should apologize about yesterday too."

name: Shiori
message: "Shall we sit over there?"
(Sit under the tree shade)

name: Shiori
message: "There we go."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sorry about yesterday. I... needed to sort things out in my head."

name: Shiori
message: "I had a lot on my mind, but it was mostly... about what comes next."

name: Shiori
message: "If... if what that man said is true, and my sister really is dead..."

name: Shiori
message: "She might have become a ghost like me, aimlessly wandering this world. And if that's the case, I want to find her."

name: Shiori
message: "But I don't have my memories, and she might not remember me either."

name: Shiori
message: "She's my precious sister, and yet... I can't remember her face or her name. I just can't. So I have no way to look for her."

name: Shiori
message: "Even if I tried to find my family, I wouldn't know their faces, or even where they moved."

name: Shiori
message: "If only I got my memories back, everything might've been solved, but I've already done everything I can..."

name: Shiori
message: "In other words, I'm stuck."

name: Shiori
message: "So... I thought about it."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm not going to give up on my sister or my parents, but I think I'll try taking a step back for now."

name: Shiori
message: "So I was thinking, maybe I'd try enjoying my life as a ghost, just like Ms. Librarian. Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "I think my lingering attachment is my family. It's no longer my death I'm fixated on, but my family, especially my sister."

name: Shiori
message: "And as long as that fixation remains, I don't think I'll ever lose my sense of self."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, right. The Death Diary. There are still plenty of pages left."

name: Shiori
message: "It's a gift from you, after all, and I don't want to leave it half finished... so, yeah."

name: Shiori
message: "I'll fill it with memories all the way to the last page... and then complete the 'me' I am now."

name: Shiori
message: "What do you think? Ehehe, I think I've found a pretty good goal."

name: Shiori
message: "As long as I'm careful with my triggers, I should be able to live peacefully as a ghost—Ah, that reminds me."

name: Shiori
message: "Your charm. Here, thank you."
I got my charm back.

name: Shiori
message: "I really want to give you a proper thank you for all your help... but unfortunately, I'm completely broke..."

name: Shiori
message: "All I can really offer is words of gratitude. I'm really sorry."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. For everything."

name: Shiori
message: "...Ehehe, that almost sounded like a farewell, didn't it?"

name: Shiori
message: "You know, this place takes me back. This is where it all started, where I asked you to help me get my memories back."

name: Shiori
message: "But that request ends here."

name: Shiori
message: "I don't even know when I'll remember, and I'd feel bad about causing you any more trouble than I already have."

name: Shiori
message: "From here on, I'm going to take things easy. No more rushing. I'll take it slow, at my own pace."

name: Shiori
message: "Even I don't understand what I really am. And yet, you still listened to my request. Thank you, truly."

name: Shiori
message: "You don't have to come here anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "...That said, saying goodbye still feels lonely, doesn't it?"

name: Shiori
message: "So, this is just me being selfish, and you don't really have to think of it as a request... but could we continue being friends?"
"Yes."
"No."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, thanks."

name: Shiori
message: "It'd really make me happy if you'd come see me once in a while. It doesn't have to be every day."

name: Shiori
message: "Now then, since we're already here, shall we go somewhere?"

name: Shiori
message: "Geez, how mean~"

name: Shiori
message: "Well, I guess this is just the right distance between us. I *am* a ghost, after all. Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "I know you can be a bit dry sometimes, but that's just one of the many things I love about you."

name: Shiori
message: "Anyway, since we're already here, I'm not letting you go home just yet. You'll keep me company, right?"

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, right. We should report to everyone who's helped us so far."

name: Shiori
message: "Well then, shall we go?"

name: Shiori
message: "Hello."
"Hello."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey hey. What, did you two make up already?"

name: Shiori
message: "We weren't really fighting, but... sorry for all the trouble I caused."

name: Shiori
message: "We're here to thank you for everything you've done for us. Thank you, truly."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Did you get your memories back?"

name: Shiori
message: "No, not yet. But I've decided not to force it anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "I don't want to trouble my buddy any further too."

name: Shiori
message: "From now on, I think I'll try doing things at my own pace."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hmm... Eh, why not? Sounds fine to me."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, Ms. Librarian."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh? What're you doing here? Weren't you stuck in the library?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I can go out now, thanks to our buddy here."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh yeah? Good for you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Indeed, thank you very much."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'm just wandering around without any goal in particular. But I'm glad I bumped into you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yooo~. What's up?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Hello. Just out for a walk. It seems I'm lucky, I didn't expect to run into you."

name: Shiori
message: "Nice timing. We were just thinking of coming to see you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I wanted to speak with you as well. I was wondering what you were planning to do next."

name: Shiori
message: "About that... I'm sorry, but I've decided to stop investigating the incident."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...I see. I understand."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sorry. You helped us so much, and yet I'm leaving things half-finished like this."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Please don't worry about it. We didn't even have any concrete leads to begin with."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "For an amateur investigation, I'd say you did quite well."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "No, please don't worry about it. There are still a few things that don't sit well with me, but..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Hm? Like what?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's nothing. For an amateur investigation, you did quite well."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm truly sorry. And thank you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You needn't thank me. Over the course of this investigation, you two have done me a favor I can never truly repay."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "How are your memories? Have you remembered anything at all?"

name: Shiori
message: "No... nothing important, at least."

name: Shiori
message: "But I'm okay now. I might remember someday, or maybe I won't. Whatever happens, happens."

name: Shiori
message: "I've decided to slow down and take things easy."

name: Shiori
message: "Also... I want to look for my sister too. I want to see her... whether she's alive or dead."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'll help."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Is this the part where I'm supposed to say something too? Well, I've got nothing better to do, so I guess I'll help."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "So then... may I ask for your help right away?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Of course."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Bring it!"

name: Shiori
message: "Will you keep being my friends?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "C'mon, stop it. You're cracking me up. You don't need to ask."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Of course, Kugayama-san."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "And... you too. Thank you. For staying by my side, buddy."

name: Shiori
message: "You might not want to hear this from a ghost, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's keep hanging out, okay?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Count me in as well. Since you can still see me, it means our tie is still intact."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I don't really get it, but hey, same here."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe... yeah."

name: Shiori
message: "My memories may not be back yet, but I've found something irreplaceable."

name: Shiori
message: "Looks like I won't be passing on just yet."

name: Shiori
message: "Here's to many more days together."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, and I heard everything. From Aoi Lumina-san."

name: Yasuda
message: "...! That damned woman...!"

name: Shiori
message: "So you really were the culprit behind the serial kidnapping murders."

name: Shiori
message: "You threatened Aoi Lumina-san and made her kidnap children."

name: Yasuda
message: "Excuse me? Shut up, stop messing with me, damn it!"

name: Yasuda
message: "I never threatened her. She did it on her own."

name: Yasuda
message: "She was infatuated with me, and tried to seduce me. Naturally, I turned her down, as I had no interest in her."

name: Yasuda
message: "She brought them to me herself, just to get my attention. I never threatened her."

name: Yasuda
message: "And yet you'd call me a murderer? Shut up, don't be absurd. I was simply playing with them, as any good friend would."

name: Shiori
message: "As any good friend would? Nobody trusted you. What parent would ever let their child play with someone like you?"

name: Yasuda
message: "Y-You... bitch!"

name: Shiori
message: "Now that I think back on it, I didn't even need to look you up. Everyone knew who you were."

name: Shiori
message: "As the sleazy man who was always ogling children at the park."

name: Yasuda
message: "Wha... you...!"

name: Yasuda
message: "You... you never fail to infuriate me, do you?!"

name: Yasuda
message: "You never change! All you do is get on my nerves!"

name: Yasuda
message: "If only you didn't exist, everything would've gone well!"

name: Yasuda
message: "If only you didn't get in my way, that girl would've been...!"

name: Shiori
message: "That girl...?"

name: Yasuda
message: "Your sister! Who else?!"

name: Shiori
message: "...If I didn't... get in your way?"

name: Shiori
message: "Oh... so that's what it was. Until now, I've never really understood why you hated me so much."

name: Shiori
message: "I saved my sister. I got in your way. And that's why you hate me..."

name: Yasuda
message: "You ruined my life! Of course I'd hate you!"

name: Yasuda
message: "If only you hadn't gotten in my way back then... If only you hadn't made a scene...!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Because of you, the police set their sights on me! I was chased by reporters! All the hard work I put into my career, ruined!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Because of you, I... I had no choice but to choose death! It's all your fault!"

name: Shiori
message: "You were just running away from your crimes. You didn't want to atone, so you chose to hate me instead."

name: Yasuda
message: "You mean to say my hate is unwarranted...? You bitch... Shut up, shut up, shut up, SHUT UP!"

name: Yasuda
message: "How can it be unwarranted when it's your fault?! Stop messing with me, shut up shut up shut up shut up shut up!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Enough."

name: Yasuda
message: "What if I take away someone precious to you? Will you finally understand my despair then?"
He's... looking this way!

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Watch out!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Can a ghost kill a human? Let's find out right now!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Buddy, run!"
"Shiori-san!"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm okay... I'm fine... really, I'm okay...!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Buddy, this way! You need to leave at once!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Hah... hahaha! Just like back then, Kugayama Shiori!"

name: Shiori
message: "I... killed you...? Lies...!"

name: Shiori
message: "You... when I was trying to save my sister..."

name: Shiori
message: "You stabbed me... with a knife... over and over...!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Yes, that's right. But you see, you brought it upon yourself, didn't you?"

name: Yasuda
message: "I'll ask you the same thing again."

name: Yasuda
message: "You want to save your sister, do you? Then could you die in her place?"

name: Yasuda
message: "You hesitated for a moment. That's when I stabbed you."

name: Yasuda
message: "You talk like you're so righteous, but in the end, all you care about is yourself!"

name: Yasuda
message: "It's because you survived. Yes, all because you lived!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Because you lived, your precious sister died instead!"

name: Shiori
message: "...Ahh, I remember now. That voice, those words, I definitely heard them."

name: Shiori
message: "I should've died instead? If I'd died, could I have protected my sister?"

name: Shiori
message: "In that case, I'll die as many times as it takes. I'll offer up my life, again, and again, and again."

name: Shiori
message: "I remember. I remember everything now."

name: Yasuda
message: "Let go of me! Or I'll stab you just like I did back then! Nice and slow—one stab at a time."

name: Shiori
message: "Do what you want...! I won't... die from this...! I'm not... dying anymore!"

name: Shiori
message: "It doesn't hurt like it did back then...! It doesn't hurt at all...! You can't kill me anymore...!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Just shut up and die already! Don't show your face in front of me ever again! It's high time I had my revenge!"

name: Shiori
message: "Revenge...? That's right, me too... I want revenge...! I want to kill you...!"

name: Shiori
message: "But it won't be me. There's someone far more deserving..."

name: Shiori
message: "The embodiment of everyone who's been wishing for your ruin for a long, long time!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Buddy, please call the 'children.' They might respond to your call."
"Come!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Hah! What's this? Trying to get on my good side? A little too late, don't you think?"

name: Shiori
message: "You still don't get it? All this rage is directed at *you*!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Huh?"

name: Shiori
message: "You don't even remember the children you killed?!"

name: Shiori
message: "You will end here, crushed by the weight of your sins!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Hah. What could one child possibly do?"

name: Yasuda
message: "Once I kill you, then I'll kill them too. And I'll be sure to have plenty of 'fun' with her."

name: Yasuda
message: "I suppose I have to thank you. I didn't think I'd get to enjoy myself even in death! HAHAHA!"
"The one who killed 'you'..."
"Was this guy."
"You don't have to hold back anymore."

name: Yasuda
message: "HAHAHA..."

name: Yasuda
message: "H-Hey, what... wh-what is this...?!"

name: Yasuda
message: "Stop, stop! What are you doing?! Wh-What do you think... you're doing?!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "What goes around comes around. As they say, you reap what you sow."

name: Yasuda
message: "Shut up! I reaped what I sowed?! I never sowed anything! I've never done anything wrong!"

name: Shiori
message: "Right, you were just having 'fun.' It'd be nice if Enma-sama understood your selfish, one-sided love."

name: Yasuda
message: "Shut up, shut up! No one messes with me! Let me go! I said let me go!"

name: Yasuda
message: "No, no, no no no no no no!"

name: Yasuda
message: "NOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!"
Not a single trace of Yasuda remained.

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Are you okay?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes... I'm fine, I'm okay."

name: Shiori
message: "The charm protected me from the knife."

name: Shiori
message: "Or so I'd like to say, but the truth is, it wasn't like in the movies. I just endured it through sheer willpower."

name: Shiori
message: "Looks like all those suicides finally paid off. I was fine even when my head got smashed open. A knife like that isn't enough to kill me."

name: Shiori
message: "See? Not a scratch. Being a ghost sure is convenient. I heal right away."
"I'm so relieved..."
"Thanks for protecting me."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sorry for worrying you."

name: Shiori
message: "No, I was the one who provoked him... If anything, I should be apologizing to you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "By that logic, this would be my fault, then. I was the one who told you to provoke him."

name: Shiori
message: "No, really, I appreciate your guidance."

name: Shiori
message: "I should apologize to her too..."

name: Shiori
message: "If she hadn't wanted to, I would've done it myself."

name: Shiori
message: "Even so, I still feel bad about pushing her into taking revenge."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If she truly didn't want to, she wouldn't have responded to our buddy's call."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "With her revenge fulfilled, she should be able to pass on now, satisfied."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Or so I thought."

name: Shiori
message: "She's just running around like usual..."

name: Shiori
message: "What about you? Are you okay? Things didn't exactly end on a pleasant note..."
"I'm okay."
"I feel refreshed."

name: Shiori
message: "I see, I'm glad to hear it. Maybe there was another way to handle it, but..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It seems our buddy couldn't become a completely good person either."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, that makes three of us, then."

name: Shiori
message: "Still... maybe there was another way to handle that..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "He was going to harm our buddy. I believe we chose the best possible course in that situation."

name: Shiori
message: "I guess... It's just..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Are his last words bothering you?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. Being stabbed in the stomach, hearing those same words again, it made me remember the moment I died."

name: Shiori
message: "Did I really hesitate? Why didn't my body move right away?"

name: Shiori
message: "Was I not brave enough to face the knife?"

name: Shiori
message: "Was I supposed to willingly choose death?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Was that why you kept killing yourself? Because you regretted it deeply?"

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Then your regret should be resolved now."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Just now, you protected our buddy without a second thought."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You've proven that you have the courage to sacrifice yourself to protect someone important to you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You needn't concern yourself with that madman's ramblings."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. I'll think of it that way."

name: Shiori
message: "I feel... surprisingly empty."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That's just how it is. Even if he were a criminal, you erased a person's soul. I'd be more worried if you felt satisfied without thinking it through."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, you're right. Ehehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "...Yeah, things got a little messy, but I did get the answers I wanted."

name: Shiori
message: "It's getting dark, so I guess we should call it a—"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "An incoming call."

name: Shiori
message: "...It must be her."
(Answer the phone)

name: Lumina
message: "Yooo, how'd it go?"

name: Shiori
message: "I thought you'd never call us again."

name: Lumina
message: "Well, that was the plan, at least. But then you guys started celebrating your happy ending."

name: Lumina
message: "And it was kinda pissing me off."

name: Lumina
message: "Y'know, I hate that stuff."

name: Lumina
message: "Sooo I had a change of heart. Figured I'd talk to you one last time."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "So you've been following us, then. Where are you now?"

name: Lumina
message: "Oh c'mon, you should've noticed by now. Look behind you."

name: Lumina
message: "Hey there~"

name: Lumina
message: "Whoa, hold up. Don't move. Just stay there, alright? Right there."

name: Lumina
message: "I don't wanna get chomped like that guy just now."

name: Lumina
message: "Let's just talk like this, yeah? A gal's gotta have her personal space."

name: Shiori
message: "Hey, Lumina-san."

name: Lumina
message: "I hate that name. Gyaruko's fine."

name: Lumina
message: "It's not sparkly enough, and it's not really normal either. Just a lame in-between."

name: Shiori
message: "Gyaruko-san."

name: Lumina
message: "Yeah?"

name: Shiori
message: "What is your goal?"

name: Lumina
message: "Tell me, have you ever killed someone since becoming a ghost?"

name: Lumina
message: "I already knew you could curse someone to death, at least in theory. Someone told me about it."

name: Lumina
message: "But I've always wondered, how do you actually do it? Like, what even is a curse anyway?"

name: Lumina
message: "Turns out, it was actually pretty easy."

name: Shiori
message: "It was... easy?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...That accident from five years ago... You were the victim, weren't you?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Wait. The driver who died under suspicious circumstances the other day..."

name: Shiori
message: "Don't tell me... it was the same person from that accident?"

name: Lumina
message: "Accident? No, no, no. That was murder. Straight-up murder."

name: Lumina
message: "Dumbass wouldn't stop bugging me about marrying him. Like, what the hell, old man? Did he seriously think I'd say yes?"

name: Lumina
message: "Anyway, I just strung him along. Then one day, bam. Hit me from behind."

name: Lumina
message: "Once he ran me over, he backed up, and did it again. Like, he really wanted to be sure I was dead. Nasty, ain't it?"

name: Lumina
message: "He killed me, so it's only right I kill him back, yeah?"

name: Lumina
message: "Well... it's not like I was actively hunting him down or anything. I thought he was in jail."

name: Lumina
message: "But I guess he got out. Probation, maybe? Or maybe he never went to jail at all, I dunno."

name: Lumina
message: "Anyway, I happened to spot him, and I figured I'd try cursing him to see what'd happen."

name: Lumina
message: "It was actually pretty easy, y'know. I just dumped all my anger and frustration at him, and boom."

name: Lumina
message: "He started twitching all over, bleeding from all his holes. It was hilarious."

name: Lumina
message: "Anyway, here's what I'm getting at."

name: Lumina
message: "If I felt like it, I could kill your buddy any time I want, just like that geezer."

name: Lumina
message: "Yeah, figured you'd be scared."

name: Lumina
message: "That old dude Yasuda started behaving after he heard it too."

name: Lumina
message: "Guess he really was a wimp deep down. Just a spoiled rich boy riding on his father's coattails."

name: Lumina
message: "You can feel my malice oozing out, can't you? Maybe it's 'cause we're both ghosts."

name: Shiori
message: "I said, what is your goal?"

name: Lumina
message: "I already told you, didn't I? I just came to talk."

name: Lumina
message: "I'm pretty sure you've got plenty to ask. C'mon, shoot."

name: Lumina
message: "Just be careful I don't snap. 'Cause even I don't know when I'll blow up."
The air feels heavy.
Gyaruko-san's curse... I feel tense, even at this distance.

name: Lumina
message: "Alright, first question! Feel free to ask anything."

name: Shiori
message: "...Is it true that you helped with the kidnappings?"
