name: Lumina
message: "Yep, it's true."

name: Lumina
message: "Oh, right. I've gotta set something straight."

name: Lumina
message: "The whole thing about me being in love with him was total BS."

name: Lumina
message: "I did hit on him, sure."

name: Lumina
message: "But the guy flat-out turned me down. Pissed me off so bad."

name: Shiori
message: "And that's why you helped with the kidnappings...?"

name: Lumina
message: "Y'see, I hate it when people look down on me. And I hate people who're probably happier than me."

name: Lumina
message: "So I figured I'd wreck his... what was it again? Right, his social standing. Yeah, I'd take it and smash it to pieces."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You... used a child? Did you even stop to think about what kind of harm that could cause?"

name: Lumina
message: "Hey, even I didn't think he'd actually kill the kid. That one's on him, not me."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...But you kept going even after the first death. Your excuse holds no water."

name: Lumina
message: "Yeah, figures. Like I said, I hate people who're probably happier than me."

name: Lumina
message: "Y'know those kids who look like they're totally loved by their parents? Like they grew up without a single worry? Don't they just piss you off?"

name: Lumina
message: "I get to blow off some steam, and I even get to ruin that geezer's life."

name: Lumina
message: "Two birds with one stone, yeah?"

name: Shiori
message: "...You said your best friend misunderstood you..."

name: Shiori
message: "Was it... really a misunderstanding?"

name: Lumina
message: "Oh, you mean Nagisa?"

name: Lumina
message: "Y'know how she always talks like she's better than you? She's so full of it."

name: Lumina
message: "Y'see, my place was kind of a wreck. My parents didn't get along, and we didn't have any cash. It was a dead end."

name: Lumina
message: "And she'd always make fun of me for it. That bitch was always looking down on me."

name: Lumina
message: "I'm sure you'd wonder why I'd even hang out with someone like that... but we were childhood friends. Guess you could call it a toxic tie."

name: Lumina
message: "We'd always hang out in her apartment hallway, just talking there while looking at the view."

name: Lumina
message: "Whenever Nagisa called for me, I'd come running. In a way, I guess I was her bitch."

name: Lumina
message: "But then she started lecturing me. You can't live like that, you'll never be like me, blah blah. So damn annoying."

name: Lumina
message: "And something just snapped. I dunno, guess I just hit my limit."

name: Lumina
message: "So I shoved her from behind."

name: Lumina
message: "Y'know how they scream while falling in dramas? But Nagisa, she just fell without a word. Really cracked me up."

name: Lumina
message: "Oh, but I did call an ambulance, okay? Told 'em my bestie fell. Pretty good of me, yeah?"

name: Lumina
message: "Y'see, she'd always sit on the railing... or wait, was it a wall? Anyways, she'd sit there, legs dangling."

name: Lumina
message: "Our neighbors had seen us there plenty of times, and I'd been drinking too."

name: Lumina
message: "So when I said she suddenly jumped mid-convo, everyone bought it. They called it a suicide, and nobody questioned it at all."

name: Lumina
message: "In a way, I guess you could call it one of my few success stories?"

name: Lumina
message: "Made me realize how surprisingly easy it is to kill someone."

name: Shiori
message: "That's it...? You helped kidnap and kill children just for that...?"

name: Lumina
message: "That was more than enough for me."

name: Lumina
message: "Alright, last one's yours, buddy. Ask whatever you want. Call it an apology for threatening you."
"Why did you lie to Shiori-san?"

name: Lumina
message: "Ah... why did I lie? Not sure which one you're talking about, but..."

name: Lumina
message: "It's not like I hate Shiorin, alright? Actually, I like her. She's nice."

name: Lumina
message: "But y'see, I hate happy people. I can't stand it when someone's happier than me."

name: Lumina
message: "Watching her get her memories back, get her happy ending, have her regrets cleared up..."

name: Lumina
message: "I mean, really? Where's the fun in that?"

name: Lumina
message: "So I figured I'd mess with her just a teeeensy bit."

name: Lumina
message: "Listening to me talk just kills the vibe, yeah?"

name: Lumina
message: "Like I've totally soured the mood? Well, that's what I'm going for."

name: Lumina
message: "See? I'm a petty gal."

name: Shiori
message: "...Was telling me about the culprit part of it?"

name: Lumina
message: "Yeah. That damn asshole just loves blaming other people. Figured the two of you would make a nice mess together."

name: Lumina
message: "I was hoping he'd dump all the blame on you and screw with your head. Y'see, he was already furious at you even before he died."

name: Shiori
message: "At me...? Why?"

name: Lumina
message: "Get this, that guy was actually your stalker."

name: Lumina
message: "He was really into your lil' sis. He wouldn't shut up about her when he was with me, saying she'd be next and all that."

name: Lumina
message: "Y'see, there are plenty of chances to snatch up little kids."

name: Lumina
message: "Like kindergarten buses, for example. Sometimes their folks don't show up, and the kid just ends up walking home alone."

name: Lumina
message: "Or when the parent's too busy glued to their phone, and the kid just wanders off on their own."

name: Lumina
message: "But you were different, Shiorin. You never left your lil' sis alone. So I kept telling him nope, not happening."

name: Lumina
message: "Then he started digging into you like crazy. Your name, your address, everything."

name: Shiori
message: "So that's why he knew about me... without me ever telling him..."

name: Lumina
message: "Yep yep. He was always watching, waiting for the perfect time to snatch up your lil' sis."

name: Lumina
message: "But his chance just never came. He kept bitching about how you were in the way. Hilarious, ain't it?"

name: Lumina
message: "I actually told him to just drop it, y'know. But he just couldn't hold back and went through with it anyway. Idiot."

name: Lumina
message: "And sure enough, you caught him. He panicked, stabbed you, and everything blew up."

name: Lumina
message: "And just like that, his life was over. There wasn't any point in going further, so I just bailed."

name: Lumina
message: "...So, he ended up killing himself, huh. I didn't know, 'cause I died before him."

name: Lumina
message: "The guy was a wimp. He probably got lonely after I died, then figured he'd rather just die than get arrested. I dunno."

name: Lumina
message: "But eh, who cares about his story? He's gone."

name: Lumina
message: "Anything else?"
"Are you satisfied now?"
"So, what do you want?"

name: Lumina
message: "'Satisfied,' eh...? I wonder. I don't even know what that would take."

name: Lumina
message: "I'd love to try it sometime, though. Being satisfied."

name: Lumina
message: "Once I take care of some stuff... maybe I'll feel just a bit better."

name: Shiori
message: "Stuff...?"

name: Lumina
message: "Yep. Y'see, Shiorin, I was thinking of putting a curse on you."

name: Lumina
message: "I wonder. Even I don't really get it myself."

name: Lumina
message: "But yeah, it's not so much what I want to do, it's what I'm about to do."

name: Lumina
message: "Y'see, Shiorin, I'm here to put a curse on you."

name: Lumina
message: "Ah, no no no. I'm not out to kill you or anything."

name: Lumina
message: "I'm talking about a curse that doesn't end with death, something that goes on for eternity."

name: Lumina
message: "You died after the geezer stabbed you, remember? You don't actually know what happened to your lil' sis after, yeah?"

name: Lumina
message: "He stabbed you, freaked out, and bailed. Do you really think it could end like that?"

name: Lumina
message: "Think about it. He was so obsessed with your lil' sis that he stalked you, remember?"

name: Lumina
message: "He stabbed you, took your lil' sis, and ran."

name: Lumina
message: "That's why I apologized on the phone earlier, said it was my fault what happened to your sis."

name: Lumina
message: "Sorry, but yeah. You've probably guessed it already."

name: Lumina
message: "Your lil' sis didn't make it."

name: Lumina
message: "And that's it. Q\&A's officially over."

name: Lumina
message: "I've told you eeeverything I know. Honestly."

name: Lumina
message: "Even the stuff that didn't really matter. Every last bit."

name: Lumina
message: "Every dumb question you asked, I answered straight. No lies, nothing left out."

name: Lumina
message: "You don't have to believe me, y'know? But it sticks, yeah? What if it's true? What if you really did die for nothing?"

name: Lumina
message: "Well? Can't pass on now, can you?"

name: Shiori
message: "It's okay."

name: Shiori
message: "Nothing you say will ever make me waver."

name: Lumina
message: "Oh yeah?"

name: Lumina
message: "Eh, whatever."

name: Lumina
message: "Guess that's that, then."

name: Lumina
message: "Hope you get to see your lil' sis."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait."

name: Lumina
message: "Hm? Yeah?"

name: Shiori
message: "You threatened my buddy earlier."

name: Lumina
message: "So?"

name: Shiori
message: "I think I finally understand something too, how ghosts vent their grudges and resentment."

name: Shiori
message: "I now know how to curse someone."

name: Shiori
message: "That's why, Gyaruko-san..."

name: Shiori
message: "If you ever lay a hand on my buddy..."

name: Shiori
message: "I'll kill you."

name: Lumina
message: "...Hah, bring it on."

name: Shiori
message: "Phew..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Are you sure you should let her go just like that?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If what she said was true, then she deserves to be punished."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And you have the right to exact it."

name: Shiori
message: "Hmmm..."

name: Shiori
message: "I don't really care."

name: Shiori
message: "Like I said, words like that won't shake me anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "So I think that's enough. I'm done. The case, the culprit, even Gyaruko-san."

name: Shiori
message: "And besides... if I really did kill her, I don't think I'd be able to face my sister."

name: Shiori
message: "Call me naive, but I want to live with my head held high."

name: Shiori
message: "Of course, it'd be a different story if she laid a hand on either of you, ehehe."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Very well. Then I'll say nothing more."

name: Shiori
message: "Mm-hm, thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "It's getting dark. Shall we call it a day?"

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you both, truly. Having you by my side was very reassuring."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "No, I've done nothing to deserve your thanks."

name: Shiori
message: "That's not true. Your presence really was reassuring, Ms. Librarian."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If anything, I'm the one who should be thanking you. Yasuda was someone I shared a bitter tie with."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You truly did a great job, Kugayama-san."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, you too."

name: Shiori
message: "Shall we part ways here? I'd like to take a little walk around the area and sort out my thoughts."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...I see. Very well."

name: Shiori
message: "Well then—Ah, right."

name: Shiori
message: "Hey, if you're up for it tomorrow, or well, it doesn't have to be tomorrow. Any day that works for you."

name: Shiori
message: "Could you come here instead of the usual park?"

name: Shiori
message: "The reason is... ehehe, it's a secret. I just thought of something nice, that's all."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay then, get home safe, okay? See you again."
"See you."
"Goodbye."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Then I'll be taking my leave as well."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay. Thank you too, Ms. Librarian."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You could say things have reached a conclusion for now. But that last part really was unnecessary, wasn't it?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That said, it seemed like Kugayama-san's mind was already made up, so there's probably nothing to worry about."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Still... I can't help but wonder whether it was actually right to just leave her be..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Perhaps the one we should be worrying about isn't you, buddy, but Kugayama-san. As you heard earlier, Aoi Lumina's strange fixation on Kugayama-san likely comes from their ties in life..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And with that final provocation, she only deepened the hostility between them... Perhaps we shouldn't have left her alone after all..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I should take a few precautions, just to be safe. Please leave the troublesome parts to me."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'll be on my way now. Good work today."
"You too."
"Goodbye."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Take care on your way home. Goodbye."
I should record what happened today on my phone.
Time to head home.

name: Shiori
message: "That lady... huh... d-did I......"

name: Shiori
message: "I... wh-what have I......"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's okay, please calm down. What happened just now was beyond our control."

name: Shiori
message: "Beyond... our control...? How was any of that... I mean... I... just... killed someone..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "As we've talked about before, ghosts have trouble regulating their—"

name: Shiori
message: "I just resorted to violence... over something like that... In the end, I'm just..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Please calm down. There was nothing we could—"

name: Shiori
message: "So it was all true..."

name: Shiori
message: "I really am... a murderer!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Kugayama-san!"
(Chase after her)
"I lost sight of her..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...We've lost her. This isn't good."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's not just anger that ghosts struggle to control. Anxiety too. Even the smallest things can send their emotions to extremes."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Kugayama-san is highly unstable right now. She shouldn't be left alone."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Do you have any idea where she might have gone?"
(Grand park)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It seems her mind is crumbling... her soul is starting to fade..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Please, call out her name. We may still be able to reach her."
"Shiori-san."
"Shiori-san."
"Shiori-san..."
(Go somewhere else)

message: "Hm? Buddy?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Why here...? Where on earth are we going?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...No, I understand. Don't worry, I won't leave you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "A shrine, is it? If a deity does indeed reside here, then perhaps there's still hope..."
